reply: We have four major field development highlights from our recent operations. First, the Shewa discovery in Waziristan commenced production on 23 March 2025, ramping toward a potential of up to 70 MMSCFD of gas plus condensate, with an Early Production Facility commissioned and a 230 km pipeline connecting the field to the national grid. Second, the Spinwam-1 well in Waziristan recorded outstanding flow rates across multiple formations and could rank among Pakistan's highest-producing individual wells if fully opened, with plans underway for a new processing facility. Third, we successfully completed Pakistan's first-ever SMART well, Bhitai-6, in April 2025, featuring advanced downhole instrumentation and remotely operated flow control valves for real-time monitoring. Finally, the Sujawal Facility expansion saw the Soho-1 discovery flow 36 MMSCFD from the Lower Goru Formation, marking the first gas discovery from Massive Sands in this vicinity, alongside new gas injection and processing capabilities for partner blocks.

reply: We have four major field development highlights from our recent operations. First, the Shewa discovery in Waziristan commenced production on 23 March 2025, ramping toward a potential of up to 70 MMSCFD of gas plus condensate, with an Early Production Facility commissioned and a 230 km pipeline connecting the field to the national grid. Second, the Spinwam-1 well in Waziristan recorded outstanding flow rates across multiple formations and could rank among Pakistan's highest-producing individual wells if fully opened, with plans underway for a new processing facility. Third, we successfully completed Pakistan's first-ever SMART well, Bhitai-6, in April 2025, featuring advanced downhole instrumentation and remotely operated flow control valves for real-time monitoring. Finally, the Sujawal Facility expansion saw the Soho-1 discovery flow 36 MMSCFD from the Lower Goru Formation, marking the first gas discovery from Massive Sands in this vicinity, alongside new gas injection and processing capabilities for partner blocks.
